description: This file contains the PHP class definition for Opencart's SubscriptionPlan model, including methods to add, edit, copy, delete, and retrieve subscription plans and their descriptions from the database.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription plans in the catalog, providing methods for CRUD operations and retrieval of subscription plan data along with descriptions.

methods.name: addSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Inserts a new subscription plan into the database and adds descriptions for different languages.

methods.name: editSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription plan and its descriptions based on subscription plan ID.

methods.name: copySubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Copies an existing subscription plan and its descriptions to create a new plan.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Deletes a subscription plan and its associated descriptions and subscriptions.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific subscription plan, including its description in the current language.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscription plans with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a subscription plan in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific subscription plan.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for all plans in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a specific subscription plan across different languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for subscription plans in a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscription plans.
